correctness.rationale: Four independent edge-direction types have respective probabilities p(1-p), p(1-p), p², (1-p)². The other hub is reached iff an s→b→t type occurs; without one, only type-III vertices can be counted. Splitting on this event yields the joint generating polynomial and conditional signed binomial correction. The two conditional parameters p²/q and p/q are strictly ordered, giving pathwise stochastic domination and the logarithmic sign crossing. Hoeffding at a threshold strictly between their means proves TV/q^n→1 for fixed interior p; differentiation produces means and pair covariance, including n=1 boundary for variance. Reconstructed independent of the finite checker.
residual_risks: Finite checkers independently corroborate finite cases only; the explicit proof, not the log, bears the unrestricted claim.
